name: facturacion-electronica-root
description: Orquestador de desarrollo: backend + frontend + electron con un solo comando.

scripts.predev: sh -c 'lsof -ti :3001 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :5173 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true'
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "wait-on tcp:3001 http://localhost:5173 && npm run start --prefix electron"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix electron
